mapper.select: SELECT SELLER_NO, EMAIL, SELLER_PW, MANAGER_NAME, PHONE, BUSINESS_NO, BUSINESS_TYPE, CEO_NAME, STORE_NAME, ZIPCODE, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, BUSINESS_DETAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_ORDER_NO, CATEGORY_NO, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, BUSINESS_CERT_URL, MAIL_ORDER_CERT_URL, APPROVAL_STATUS, REJECT_REASON FROM SELLER WHERE EMAIL = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE SELLER SET ZIPCODE = #{zipcode}, BUSINESS_ADDRESS = #{businessAddress}, BUSINESS_DETAIL_ADDRESS = #{businessDetailAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MAIL_ORDER_NO = #{mailOrderNo}, CATEGORY_NO = #{categoryNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, BANK_NAME = #{bankName}, ACCOUNT_NO = #{accountNo}, ACCOUNT_HOLDER = #{accountHolder}, BUSINESS_CERT_URL = #{businessCertUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MAIL_ORDER_CERT_URL = #{mailOrderCertUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPROVAL_STATUS = CASE WHEN APPROVAL_STATUS IN ('입점 대기', '반려') THEN '심사 중' ELSE APPROVAL_STATUS END, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SELLER ( SELLER_NO, EMAIL, SELLER_PW, MANAGER_NAME, PHONE, BUSINESS_NO, BUSINESS_TYPE, CEO_NAME, STORE_NAME, APPROVAL_STATUS, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_SELLER.NEXTVAL, #{email}, #{sellerPw}, #{managerName}, #{phone}, #{businessNo}, #{businessType}, #{ceoName}, #{storeName}, '입점 대기', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE SELLER SET APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo}
mapper.select: SELECT SELLER_NO, EMAIL, MANAGER_NAME, PHONE, BUSINESS_NO, BUSINESS_TYPE, CEO_NAME, STORE_NAME, ZIPCODE, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, BUSINESS_DETAIL_ADDRESS, MAIL_ORDER_NO, CATEGORY_NO, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_NO, ACCOUNT_HOLDER, BUSINESS_CERT_URL, MAIL_ORDER_CERT_URL, APPROVAL_STATUS, REJECT_REASON, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_DATE FROM SELLER ORDER BY SELLER_NO DESC
